about: THE list of locations no P03 prototype root may be inside or contain. Read by the Rust guard (orgtree-prototype-guard, compiled in) and by the Python door hook (engine/backend/orgtree/p03_door.py). A location is base + parts, where base is the FIRST non-empty environment variable named in base_env; a location whose base_env are all unset is skipped. unconditional=false means the location is unlocked only when it is itself a valid prototype root (marker bound to exactly its canonical path) lying outside every unconditional location.
